title: Magic Mike "Pony" Dance Analysis (How To Dance Like Magic Mike)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor analyzes a movie dance performance scene by scene, breaking down movement elements with voiceover commentary. He speaks directly to the camera in front of a red curtain between analysis clips.

lesson_structure.note: Clip from Magic Mike dancing to Pony
Instructor introduces the Magic Mike Pony routine breakdown
Analysis of the routine starting with standing and jacket removal
Body height variations and body roll analysis
Knee slide and floor movement breakdown
Chest pops and dolphin dive breakdown
Stage progression and crowd interaction analysis
Summary of movements shown in the routine

cues: bending the knees and dropping centre of gravity
safety: Wouldn't recommend doing this into the crowd in real life

steps_taught.name: Hip thrusts
steps_taught.description: Three hip thrusts timed with the beat of the music

steps_taught.name: Body roll
steps_taught.description: Classic male stripper body roll movement

steps_taught.name: Knee slide
steps_taught.description: Transition from body roll into a knee slide on the floor

steps_taught.name: Monkey flip
steps_taught.description: A neat transition flip to get back to standing

steps_taught.name: Dolphin dive
steps_taught.description: An acrobatic crowd-pleasing move using upper body momentum

what_works: Replaying clips in slow motion to highlight specific movement details
Dividing the routine into distinct key elements like timing and body height
what_hinders: Relying entirely on movie clips rather than demonstrating steps in person

quotes.text: It can be broken down into exactly three different parts.
Did you notice how he was really bending his knees?
The knee slide, once again, from the body roll to the knee slide.
It's what we call a crowd pleasing move.

evidence_segments.observation: A male dancer performs on a stage in a club setting, moving from floor work to a handstand.
A man in a white polo shirt speaks directly to the camera in front of a red curtain backdrop.
A dancer on stage performs repeated hip thrust movements.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact foot placement due to dark lighting

evidence_segments.observation: A shirtless dancer performs an acrobatic dive motion across the stage floor in slow motion.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: full weight distribution during the landing

extraction.distinctive_method: Analyzing a commercial film performance scene by scene as a proxy for live dance instruction.
